claim_ceiling: Three independent breakthrough representations validated (linear_metric JP=0.707, mahalanobis JP=0.689, hybrid_stabilized JP=0.682) — all pass BOTH adversarial gates on frozen harness v3 seed=42. center_projected_64dim confirmed as validated DEFAULT reference on its native configuration. hybrid_cited_0.3 validated as best balance (JP=0.955). Citation role modeling deferred (data engineering gap). Jurist framework ready.
evidence_summary: Independent validation (validation_breakthrough/validation_results.json) confirms 4/4 breakthrough representations pass both adversarial gates: center_projected (LangDom=0.763, JuristPref=0.528), linear_metric_epoch4 (LangDom=0.673, JuristPref=0.707), hybrid_stabilized_epoch1 (LangDom=0.660, JuristPref=0.682), mahalanobis_metric_epoch4 (LangDom=0.678, JuristPref=0.689). Metric learning training logs show 18+ consecutive valid epochs. Hybrid stabilized shows 6 consecutive valid epochs. Standalone benchmarks (16-benchmark frozen harness) confirm center_projected (9/10 pass) and hybrid_cited_0.3 (9/10 pass). Comprehensive evaluation (11 representations) confirms only cited_decisions_tfidf and hybrid_cited_0.3 pass both gates among unsupervised signals. All 6 citation role embeddings correctly identified as overclustering artifacts (zero matrices from BGE/ATF format mismatch). 3 legal embeddings correctly fail adversarial gates (LangDom≈1.0). Negative results preserved as first-class evidence. Reproducibility scripts present with deterministic seeds. One methodology discrepancy: center_projected JuristPref=0.982 in report comes from 64-dim/1200-decision standalone harness vs 0.528 from 384-dim/1000-decision validation harness — not comparable configurations.
